paragraphs: ImageResizer is a lightweight tool (CLI & Web UI) that converts images from the internet or your local machine into crisp, distortion-free desktop wallpapers. It preserves image sharpness whether you are upscaling a small image or downscaling a high-resolution photo.
features: Flexible Input: Load images directly from an HTTP/HTTPS URL or upload from your local disk.

Smart Aspect-Ratio Cropping: Center-crops images to match your target desktop resolution (Full HD, 2K QHD, 4K UHD, Ultrawide, 16:10, or custom dimensions) before scaling—no stretching or wasted GPU cycles.

AI Super-Resolution Upscaling: Automatically downloads and runs Real-ESRGAN-ncnn-vulkan (realesrgan-x4plus, realesrgan-x4plus-anime, realesr-animevideov3) when the source image is smaller than the target resolution.
High-Precision Downscaling: Uses LANCZOS resampling paired with UnsharpMask micro-contrast restoration to keep fine details razor-sharp when shrinking large images.
Cross-Platform: Automatically fetches the appropriate realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan binary for Windows, Linux, or macOS on first run.
